title: auritus login left a stray project-local .auritus/config with placeholder endpoints, shadowing the real global config
description:
Correcting the title as filed: auritus login itself was never the actual
cause -- traced it down and neither login.py nor auth.py write config at
all. The real mechanism, found by reading config.py closely:

_default_save_path() in cli/src/auritus/config.py:
  if local_config_path().is_file(): return local
  if global_config_path().is_file(): return global
  return local_config_path()   <- fallback was LOCAL, not global

Any unqualified save_config() call (auritus config set, or a test) that
runs when NEITHER a local nor global config exists yet silently creates a
new PROJECT-LOCAL .auritus/config -- in whatever directory happens to be
the process's cwd -- rather than the global one a user would expect
(matching how auritus deploy always writes to global_config_path()
explicitly, and how the config command's own --help describes itself:
'global or ./.auritus/config', implying global is the default).

The concrete incident: cli/tests/test_config.py, test_save_and_load_roundtrip,
patched auritus.config.config_dir (the GLOBAL directory function) but never
patched or chdir'd away from the real cwd, so its own save_config(cfg) call
-- with cfg['api_endpoint'] set to a placeholder example URL for the test's
own assertions -- landed on the unmocked, real local_config_path(). Running
this test from the repo root, or from cli/, leaves a real
<cwd>/.auritus/config behind with that placeholder content. Confirmed this
happened twice this session: once in the repo root (someone ran the suite
from there earlier), and once in cli/ when I ran the test suite myself as
part of an unrelated verification -- both silently broke the local worker
for any invocation from those directories afterward (real Cognito/API
endpoint config shadowed by the placeholder), which is what looked like a
fresh auritus-login problem when the user actually hit it.

Fixed both the root cause and the specific incident:
1. auritus/config.py: _default_save_path() now defaults to GLOBAL when
   neither file exists. A local config remains fully supported and still
   takes priority when one already exists -- it is just no longer created
   as a side effect of the first unqualified write.
2. test_config.py: added monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path) so the test's own
   local_config_path() resolves inside the sandbox too, matching what the
   config_dir() patch was already doing for the global path.

Verified: full cli test suite passes (30/30), and a repeated run of the
previously-guilty test no longer creates any .auritus directory outside
tmp_path.
